# Mehrad Yaghoubi

Mehrad Yaghoubi (مهراد یعقوبی, also written Merhrad Yaghoubi) is completing an M.Sc. in Artificial Intelligence at Islamic Azad University, Karaj, Iran, and preparing to defend his thesis. He is seeking a fully funded PhD position in computer vision, visual speech recognition (VSR), efficient deep learning or model optimization.

His research examines uncertainty in VSR and decision making in Go. He uses PyTorch with CUDA for GPU model training and inference. His applied work includes chatbots and web integrations.

## Research papers

- [Entropy-Gated Online Self-Distillation for Visual Speech Recognition Based on Connectionist Temporal Classification](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=6831426). Mehrad Yaghoubi and Azam Bastanfard, 2026. Preprint under review at The Visual Computer. The method uses frame-level uncertainty to guide self-distillation in a lightweight VSR model, with negligible additional inference cost.
- [Belief-Guided Decision Making with Uncertainty Gating in the Game of Go](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.26946). Mehrad Yaghoubi, Azam Bastanfard, Abbas Jalilvand, and Ashkan Rezaei, 2026. arXiv preprint.

## Selected work

- AI Specialist at Ghasedak Peik Shahr for two months in 2026. Developed a Persian travel chatbot with three WordPress plugins, a competitor price checker, and an operator training dashboard and homepage theme for Parsegasht. [Website](https://parsegasht.com/).
- Co-founder at Fidar Technology Fartak for 1.5 years. The university startup project explored games informed by psychology for crime prevention and was not formally incorporated.
- [PyLipExtractor](https://github.com/MehradYaghoubi/pylipextractor). open-source Python package for extracting lip regions from video with MediaPipe Face Mesh. Includes temporal smoothing, optional illumination normalization, configurable processing, and CPU/CUDA support.
- [Shofazh Yaghoubi](http://shofazhyaghoubi.ir/): a service and commerce website for a heating business.
- OCR tool using an external API.
- Personal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) chatbot, in development.

## Education and teaching

- M.Sc. in Artificial Intelligence, Islamic Azad University, Karaj: in progress, preparing for thesis defense.
- B.Sc. in Computer Science (Software Engineering), Islamic Azad University, Karaj.
- Research activity at the university research center for 1.5 years.
- Software instructor at the Faculty of Work and Skills, Islamic Azad University, Karaj, for one year.
- Programming instructor at Net College Institute for one year.
- Robotics instructor at Mohandesin Bartar Institute for one year.
- Teaching experience in data structures, programming, robotics, C#, and Unity.
